mapper.select: SELECT 'OR' AS recordType, 'OR' AS recordDetailType, '처방' AS itemType, '처방' || '(' || TO_CHAR(A.ORD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')' AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.ORD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, NULL AS keyId, NULL AS pactId, A.MED_PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.MED_PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MOOORPTD A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.ORD_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL AND A.ODDSC_TP_CD IN ('C', 'D') AND A.ORD_GRP_CD NOT IN ('06', '08') AND A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.PBSO_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.MED_PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.MED_PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) GROUP BY A.PT_NO, A.MED_PACT_TP_CD, A.ORD_DT, A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD, writingDeptNm

SELECT 'EX' AS recordType, 'EX_PICTURE' AS recordDetailType, '영상검사' AS itemType, A.EXM_CD_NM AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(M.PHTG_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, C.PT_HME_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = C.PT_HME_DEPT_CD AND Z.HSP_TP_CD = C.HSP_TP_CD) AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, M.ORD_CD AS keyId, C.PACT_ID AS pactId, C.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(C.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, M.IPTN_NO AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MSERMAAD M INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSERMMMC A ON A.EXM_CD = M.ORD_CD INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOOOREXM C ON M.ORD_ID = C.ORD_ID WHERE M.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND M.PHTG_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND M.ORD_CTG_CD IN ('BR1', 'BN1', 'BTR') AND M.EXM_PRGR_STS_CD IN ('N', 'D') AND M.HSP_TP_CD = C.HSP_TP_CD AND C.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', C.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd})

SELECT 'EX' AS recordType, 'EX_PATHOLOGY' AS recordDetailType, '병리검사' AS itemType, CASE WHEN A.MAIN_PKRG_NM IS NULL THEN B.EXM_CTG_NM ELSE B.EXM_CTG_NM || ' ' || A.MAIN_PKRG_NM END AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.ACPT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, A.MED_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.MED_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, A.PTHL_NO AS keyId, D.PACT_ID AS pactId, D.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(D.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, A.PTHL_NO AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MSEPMPMD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMCTC B ON A.EXM_CTG_CD = B.EXM_CTG_CD INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMCED C ON A.SPCM_NO = C.SPCM_NO INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOOOREXM D ON C.ORD_ID = D.ORD_ID WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.ACPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PLEX_PRGR_STS_CD IN ('N', 'D', 'C') AND D.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', D.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd})

SELECT DISTINCT 'EX' AS recordType, 'EX_SPECIMEN' AS recordDetailType, '검체검사' AS itemType, Q.ORD_SLIP_CTG_NM || DECODE(M.EMRG_YN, 'Y', '[EM]', '') AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.ACPT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, M.MTD_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = M.MTD_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, A.MED_EXM_CTG_CD AS keyId, NULL AS pactId, M.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(M.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, A.SPCM_NO AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, (SELECT DECODE(Z.GENE_EXM_PRNT_RTC_YN, 'Y', 'Y', '') FROM ODS.S_MSELMEBM Z WHERE Z.EXM_CD = A.EXM_CD) AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MSELMAID A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSELMCED M ON A.SPCM_NO = M.SPCM_NO INNER JOIN ODS.S_CCOOCCSC Q ON A.MED_EXM_CTG_CD = Q.ORD_SLIP_CTG_CD WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.ACPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.RSLT_BRFG_YN = 'Y'

SELECT 'EX' AS recordType, 'EX_FUNCTION' AS recordDetailType, '기능검사' AS itemType, A.EXM_CD_NM AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(M.PHTG_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, C.PT_HME_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = C.PT_HME_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, M.IPTN_NO AS keyId, C.PACT_ID AS pactId, C.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(C.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, NULL AS mdfmId, NULL AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, M.IPTN_NO AS examKey, DECODE(M.PACS_IMG_IPTN_YN, 'Y', DECODE((SELECT Z.USE_YN FROM ODS.S_MSERMZED Z WHERE Z.ORD_CD = M.ORD_CD AND Z.EXCP_CTG_CD = '007'), 'Y', 'C', 'P'), '') AS pacsImgIptnCd, M.ACCS_ID AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MSERMAAD M INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSERMMMC A ON M.ORD_CD = A.EXM_CD INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOOOREXM C ON M.ORD_ID = C.ORD_ID WHERE M.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND M.ORD_CTG_CD NOT IN ('BR1', 'BN1', 'BTR') AND M.PHTG_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND C.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', C.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND M.EXM_PRGR_STS_CD IN ('N', 'D')

SELECT 'SC' AS recordType, 'SC' AS recordDetailType, '스캔자료' AS itemType, ODF_PAGE_NM AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.ORD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, CASE WHEN INSTR(A.MTD_DEPT_CD, '/') != 0 THEN SUBSTR(A.MTD_DEPT_CD, 0, INSTR(A.MTD_DEPT_CD, '/') - 1) ELSE A.MTD_DEPT_CD END AS writingDeptCd, C.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, A.BRCD_SEQ AS keyId, NULL AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, REGEXP_REPLACE(A.IMG_SV_ADDR_NM, '\\', '/') AS examKey, A.IMG_SV_ADDR_NM AS examKeyOrign, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MSMCSMTM A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MSMCSOCC B ON A.SCAN_FORM_CD = B.ODF_PAGE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM C ON A.MTD_DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.ORD_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND NVL(A.SCAN_TP_CD, 'A') NOT IN ('M', 'O') ORDER BY writingDate DESC, A.BRCD_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_OBSERVATION' AS recordDetailType, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003023' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.CLCO_REC_WRT_PATH_TP_CD) AS itemType, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003023' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.CLCO_REC_WRT_PATH_TP_CD) AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.UITM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, NULL AS writingDeptCd, NULL AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerNm, A.PACT_TP_CD || '_' || A.PT_NO || '_' || A.UITM_DT AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL As ptMedDeptNm, 1 AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRNNRVAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRVAE B ON A.CLCO_REC_ITEM_ID = B.CLCO_REC_ITEM_ID WHERE PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.CLCO_REC_WRT_PATH_TP_CD = '01' AND A.UITM_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) ORDER BY writingDate DESC

SELECT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_INPATIENT' AS recordDetailType, C.NREC_CLS_NM AS itemType, B.NREC_FORM_NM AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.REC_WRT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, A.FSR_STF_NO AS writerStfNo, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.FSR_STF_NO) AS writerStfNm, A.NREC_ID AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD AS ptMedDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, 1 AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRNNRFAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRCBC B ON A.NREC_FORM_CD = B.NREC_FORM_CD AND B.NREC_CLS_CD = '01' AND B.LST_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRCAC C ON B.NREC_CLS_CD = C.NREC_CLS_CD AND C.LST_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.REC_WRT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} order by writingDate desc

SELECT DISTINCT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_EXECUTE' AS recordDetailType, '간호활동수행기록' AS itemType, '간호활동수행기록' || '(' || A.UITM_DT || ')' AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.UITM_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, NULL AS writingDeptCd, NULL AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL As writerStfNm, A.PACT_TP_CD || '_' || A.PT_NO || '_' || A.UITM_DT AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, NULL AS ptMedDeptCd, NULL AS ptMedDeptNm, 1 AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRNNRAAD A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.UITM_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} order by writingDate desc

SELECT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_FALL' AS recordDetailType, '낙상위험도평가' AS itemType, '낙상위험도평가' AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, NULL AS writingDeptCd, NULL AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerStfNm, A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD AS ptMedDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, A.WRT_SEQ AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MOPPCIED A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY writingDate DESC, A.WRT_SEQ DESC

SELECT DISTINCT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_BEDSORE' AS recordDetailType, '욕창간호기록' AS itemType, '욕창간호기록' AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, NULL AS writingDeptCd, NULL AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerStfNm, A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE AS keyId, NULL AS pactId, 'I' AS pactTpCd, '입원' AS pactTpNm, A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD AS ptMedDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, NULL AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRNNRPCD A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND 'I' = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', 'I', #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY writingDate DESC

SELECT 'NR' AS recordType, 'NR_BEDSORE_EVALUATION' AS recordDetailType, '욕창위험도평가' AS itemType, '욕창위험도평가' AS itemNm, TO_CHAR(A.INPT_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS writingDate, NULL AS writingDeptCd, NULL AS writingDeptNm, NULL AS writerStfNo, NULL AS writerStfNm, A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, A.PACT_TP_CD AS pactTpCd, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpNm, A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD AS ptMedDeptCd, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD) AS ptMedDeptNm, A.WRT_SEQ AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, 1 AS mdfmId, 1 AS mdfmFomSeq, NULL AS mdrcId, NULL AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MTD_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} ORDER BY writingDate DESC, A.WRT_SEQ DESC
